hypothesis: Fixing both the deadline-swallow bug (compiler_draft.py:2313) and adding check_decode_deadline() to the compiler-tree per-position loop (twotower.py _compiler_ltr_decode_one), on top of the already-landed lexer/scanner cache (#1173), lets the exposure12 quality-champion smoke suite's 3 records (smoke_hero_01, smoke_button_01, smoke_callout_01) finish inside decode_timeout_seconds=30, where neither the lexer cache alone nor the pre-fix baseline did.

item_1.change: build_completion_forest's try/except around the completion-domain lookup gains `except TimeoutError: raise` before the existing bare `except Exception: return CompletionForest((), "none")`, so a cooperative decode-deadline TimeoutError (slm_training.models.decode_stats.check_decode_deadline) propagates instead of being recorded as a grammar dead-end. item_2.change: _compiler_ltr_decode_one's per-position `while len(prefix) < length and prefix[-1] != self.tokenizer.eos_id:` loop calls check_decode_deadline() at the top of every iteration, matching the existing cooperative-deadline coverage already present in _constrained_ltr_repair (line ~4906) and the MaskGIT loop (line ~13266) since PR #1167. _compiler_ltr_decode_batch delegates to _compiler_ltr_decode_one per row, so this single loop-head edit covers both the single- and batch-decode compiler-tree paths.

decision: REJECT the hypothesis as stated: fixing both the deadline-swallow bug and adding cooperative deadline checks to the compiler-tree loop does NOT get any of the 3 smoke records to finish inside decode_timeout_seconds=30. All three records still consume the full budget (latency_ms_p50 29.99s-30.10s, matching the pre-fix and lexer-cache-only wall-clock shape almost exactly). ACCEPT the fix on its own narrower, correctly-scoped claim: decode_outcome classification is now honest. All 3 records now consistently report `runtime_timeout` (was fallback_output/fallback_output/fallback_output before any fix, and fallback_output/runtime_timeout/fallback_output after the lexer-cache-only fix -- an inconsistent, partially-masked mix). The fix eliminates that inconsistency and the false-positive certified-fallback classification, at the cost of revealing that smoke_callout_01's previously-reported meaningful_program_rate=1.0 was a scoring artifact of the swallow bug: its true post-fix rate is 0.0, same as the other two records.
interpretation: This confirms the deadline-swallow finding's root-cause chain end to end: the compiler-tree per-position loop genuinely has no way to finish early once it starts spending multi-second compiler_ms per build_completion_forest call inside decode_timeout_seconds=30 -- the fix changes what the harness truthfully reports about that outcome, not how fast the model decodes. The underlying performance blocker (build_completion_forest costing ~1-10s per call even with the lexer cache, per decode-compiler-tree-lexer-cache-hero-rerun-20260728.md's per_call analysis) is untouched and remains the actual next-steps item for making these records finish early rather than merely being classified correctly when they do not.
scope_note: The exposure12 quality-champion's own reported smoke-suite quality is now WORSE by this honest measurement (0/3 meaningful vs the previously reported 1/3) -- this is a correction of a measurement bug, not a claim the model got worse. No promotion or roster claim is made or implied either direction.
